name: Elm Tree Diner
closed_reason: Shut since a deliberately set fire in late July 2025; the building owner says it will go up for sale and that it is not reopening (BDN, Feb. 2026).

name: Luiggi's Pizzeria
closed_reason: Owners announced in August 2025 that the longtime pizzeria was closing for good, five months after reopening under new owners.

name: Farmington Diner
closed_reason: Closed permanently at 7 p.m. Aug. 10, 2026; El Tequila is moving into the space.

name: Long Lake Bar and Grill
closed_reason: Lakeside restaurant in St. David (village of Madawaska) 'ceased operations' effective immediately in January 2025 after poor snowmobile seasons; no reopening found.

name: Gifford's Famous Ice Cream (Farmington stand)
closed_reason: Closed for good in 2024 after two Sandy River floods in 2023 (Central Maine, March 2026).

name: Gifford's Famous Ice Cream (Auburn stand)
closed_reason: Gifford's announced the Auburn stand's closure shortly after its February 2023 factory fire (Central Maine, March 2026).
